name: Bill Faraj
pull: The procedure itself took about five minutes.
body: I had my vasectomy with Dr Geoff Cashion and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. The communication leading up to the procedure was excellent — clear instructions, helpful reminders, and detailed information that genuinely put me at ease. On the day, I arrived on time, was greeted by the nurse, and everything ran efficiently and professionally. The procedure itself took about five minutes. It was incredibly smooth, completely pain-free, and far less daunting than I had imagined. Dr Geoff was calm, confident and reassuring throughout, which made a big difference. I was able to drive myself home immediately afterwards without any issues. If you're considering a vasectomy and feeling unsure, I can honestly say the process was seamless and far easier than expected.

name: J M
pull: Why wouldn't you use a specialist?
body: Excellent. I heard of all the horror from other practices but Dr Valentine was professional and excellent. They are specialists in their field so the question needs to be asked why wouldn't you use a specialist like Dr Valentine. When I tell all my friends they are surprised about how well it went.

name: Dani GM
body: My husband's procedure only took about 10 minutes — it was super quick. He came out without pain and was walking normally. He even drove home afterwards. What helped him the most once the anesthesia wore off was applying ice constantly. It's been 10 days since his surgery and he no longer feels any pain or discomfort. His surgery was on a Friday, and he returned to work on Wednesday (his job involves physical labor). His doctor was Geoff Cashion, highly recommended.

name: Lorralee Thompson
pull: Discomfort for 2 seconds with the needle. The rest was painless.
body: Dr Geoff Cashion was an awesome bloke, made the procedure an easy experience. The procedure itself was awkward to begin with but no pain, only the discomfort for 2 seconds with the needle — the rest was painless, easy and fast.

name: Brian Gomez
pull: Pre-op and post-op documentation was thorough and informative.
body: Easy to book online for an appointment and could change easily if needed. Pre-op and post-op documentation was thorough and informative. On the day of op, doctor and nurse was re-assuring, efficient in their service and completed my op without any issues. Good experience so far. Thanks again.

name: Jamie Gilmore
pull: An excellent team of medical professionals.
body: Very friendly and professional. Dr Cashion made me feel very relaxed and informed about everything and his team were incredibly kind and supportive throughout with any questions I had. An excellent team of medical professionals.

name: Peter Peterson
body: Quick and painless. Recovery was a little slower than expected but I put this down to not following the care advice and participating in a certain physical activity within 24 hours instead of waiting the recommended 7 days. Happy with the service. Would recommend.

name: Luke Jacobz
pull: Dr Cashion was calm, friendly and comforting.
body: Fabulous experience. Dr Cashion was calm, friendly and comforting. I was so impressed, that would easily go through that multiple times.. clearly not necessary..

name: Antonio Castillo
pull: They are the medical professionals to see.
body: Today I had my vasectomy. It was performed by Dr Geoff Cashion and his assistant. They were fantastic and caring. Anyone considering a vasectomy, they are the medical professionals to see.
